title: tc-gap-exposure
description:
Gaps or risks and whether anyone is working on them – severity, the item and its priority, coverage, owner and
what's invested – with the severe uncovered ones called out, groups by priority or severity, and an uncovered-only
filter.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

gaps.description: The gaps, in the order to show them within a group

groupBy.description: Groups the list by the item's priority or by severity. Changed by the user unless a tc-group-change listener calls preventDefault()

uncoveredOnly.description: Shows only gaps with no work on them. Changed by the user unless a tc-filter-change listener calls preventDefault()

exposureSeverities.description: The severities that count as exposure when nothing is in work

severityLabels.description: The severities' names, merged over the defaults (Critical, High, Medium, Low)

tiers.description: The priority tiers' names by number, merged over the defaults (Top priority, High, Medium, Watching)

currency.description: The currency of `budget`, as an ISO code

locale.description: The language for numbers and money, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

item.description: The topic or project it belongs to

priority.description: That item's priority tier, from 1 (the top); named by `tiers`

work.description: How many pieces of work are on it; 0 or unset means none – uncovered

owner.description: Who owns it, as a name (shown as initials)
